title: Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans — Service Menu by Plan
content:
# Service Menu by Plan — Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans

This menu lists what each Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans tier includes, per visit and over the term, and the customer-pay oil charges.

## Oil at each visit

| Plan | Engine oil included | Quarts included per visit | Customer-pay charge per quart beyond the included quarts (USD) | Customer-pay synthetic upgrade surcharge (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Care Essentials 2-Visit | Conventional or blend | 5 | 8.95 | 29.95 |
| Kessler Care Essentials 4-Visit | Conventional or blend | 5 | 8.95 | 29.95 |
| Kessler Care Plus 6-Visit | Full synthetic | 6 | 8.95 | 0.00 |
| Kessler Care Plus 8-Visit | Full synthetic | 6 | 8.95 | 0.00 |
| Kessler Care Premium 10-Visit | Full synthetic | 8 | 8.95 | 0.00 |
| Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit | Full synthetic | 7 | 8.95 | 0.00 |

The synthetic upgrade surcharge is charged on customer pay when full synthetic oil is required or requested on a conventional plan.

## Services at every visit

| Plan | Tire rotation | Multi-point inspection | Battery test | Fluid top-off | Tire balancing with each rotation | Complimentary wash |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Care Essentials 2-Visit | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Kessler Care Essentials 4-Visit | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |
| Kessler Care Plus 6-Visit | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes |
| Kessler Care Plus 8-Visit | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Kessler Care Premium 10-Visit | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |

## Items at particular visit numbers

| Plan | Cabin air filter at visit number(s) | Engine air filter at visit number(s) | Front wiper blades at visit number(s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Care Essentials 2-Visit | none | none | none |
| Kessler Care Essentials 4-Visit | none | none | none |
| Kessler Care Plus 6-Visit | 4 | 6 | none |
| Kessler Care Plus 8-Visit | 4 and 8 | 8 | 4 |
| Kessler Care Premium 10-Visit | 4 and 8 | 6 and 10 | 5 and 10 |
| Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit | 6 and 12 | 6 and 12 | none |

## Items over the term

| Plan | One brake fluid exchange during the term | One coolant exchange during the term | Alignment check once a year |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Care Essentials 2-Visit | No | No | No |
| Kessler Care Essentials 4-Visit | No | No | No |
| Kessler Care Plus 6-Visit | No | No | No |
| Kessler Care Plus 8-Visit | No | No | Yes |
| Kessler Care Premium 10-Visit | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit | No | No | No |

Hypothetical reading example: on a hypothetical visit where 2 quarts of oil are needed beyond the plan's included quarts, the customer-pay oil charge is 2 times 8.95, or 17.90.
